kurals.tr: Utranoi Nondral Uyirkkurukan Seyyaamai / Atre Thavaththir Kuru
kurals.m: The nature of religious discipline consists, in the endurance (by the ascetic) of the sufferings which it brings on himself, and in abstaining from giving pain to others

kurals.tr: Thavamum Thavamutaiyaarkku Aakum Adhanai / Aqdhilaar Merkol Vadhu
kurals.m: Austerities can only be borne, and their benefits enjoyed, by those who have practised them (in a former birth); it will be useless for those who have not done so, to attempt to practise them (now)

kurals.tr: Thurandhaarkkuth Thuppuravu Venti Marandhaarkol / Matrai Yavarkal Thavam
kurals.m: It is to provide food etc, for the ascetics who have abandoned (the desire of earthly possessions) that other persons have forgotten (to practise) austerity ?

kurals.tr: Onnaarth Theralum Uvandhaarai Aakkalum / Ennin Thavaththaan Varum
kurals.m: If (the ascetic) desire the destruction of his enemies, or the aggrandizement of his friends, it will be effected by (the power of) his austerities

kurals.tr: Ventiya Ventiyaang Keydhalaal Seydhavam / Eentu Muyalap Patum
kurals.m: Religious dislipline is practised in this world, because it secures the attainment of whatever one may wish to enjoy (in the world to come)

kurals.tr: Thavanj Cheyvaar Thangarumanj Cheyvaarmar / Rallaar Avanjeyvaar Aasaiyut Pattu
kurals.m: Those discharge their duty who perform austerities; all others accomplish their own destruction, through the entanglement of the desire (of riches and sensual pleasure)

kurals.tr: Sutachchutarum Ponpol Olivitum Thunpanjjch / Utachchuta Norkir Pavarkku
kurals.m: Just as gold is purified as heated in the fire, will those shine, who have endured the burning of pain (in frequent austerities)

kurals.tr: Thannuyir Thaanarap Petraanai Enaiya / Mannuyi Rellaan Thozhum
kurals.m: All other creatures will worship him who has attained the control of his own soul

kurals.tr: Kootram Kudhiththalum Kaikootum Notralin / Aatral Thalaippat Tavarkkul
kurals.m: Those who have attained the power which religious discipline confers, will be able also to pass the limit of Yama, (the God of death)

kurals.tr: Ilarpala Raakiya Kaaranam Norpaar / Silarpalar Nolaa Thavar
kurals.m: Because there are few who practise austerity and many who do not, there are many destitute and few rich in this world
